name: ux2-u17-ux2css
prompt:
Write public/css/ux2.css (new file, about 110 lines): STU-UX2 styles for the queue, players, toasts, focus rings, search and keyboard map, loaded last. style.css (loaded first) defines these custom properties, use them: --bg, --surface, --surface-2, --surface-3, --text, --text-2, --accent (orange on dark, orange-ink #8a5a00 on light), --accent-hover, --active-bg, --active-text, --border, --input-bg, --danger, --shadow, --radius (10px), --radius-sm (6px), --white, --mist, --plum, --orange, --orange-light, --orange-ink; ux1.css adds --space-1 8px, --space-2 16px, --space-3 24px, --text-xs 12px, --text-sm 13px, --text-md 15px, --text-lg 18px, --radius-card 12px, --shadow-card, --motion 170ms. Dark is the default; light comes from prefers-color-scheme in style.css, so never hard-code text colours on themed surfaces (the header is purple in both themes). Motion only on transform and opacity (170 ms), never transition colours or borders; respect prefers-reduced-motion. Text needs WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1) in both themes.
1. Queue chip on a card's thumbnail (`.job-thumb` is position relative): `.queue-info` position absolute, left 8px, bottom 8px, padding 3px 9px, radius 999px, --text-xs, weight 700, font-variant-numeric tabular-nums, color var(--mist), background rgba(12, 9, 23, 0.82) (dark in both themes, so the light text keeps its contrast).
2. Failed card: `.fail-reason` flex 1 1 100%, --text-sm, weight 600, color var(--danger), overflow-wrap anywhere, line-height 1.35. `.job-card[data-status="error"] .job-actions, .job-card[data-status="cancelled"] .job-actions` flex-wrap wrap. `.act-btn.danger` color var(--danger).
3. Players: `.wave-player` display grid, grid-template-columns 36px minmax(0, 1fr) auto, align-items center, gap 8px, width 100%. `.wave-play` 36 x 36 px, round, border 0, background var(--active-bg), color var(--active-text), grid centred, cursor pointer; `.wave-play .i-pause` display none; `.wave-player.playing .wave-play .i-play` display none and `.i-pause` display inline. `canvas.wave` width 100%, height 40px, cursor pointer, color var(--accent). `.wave-time` --text-xs, color var(--text-2), tabular-nums. `.job-card video` width 100%, display block.
4. Every card control is the same height: `.job-actions .act-btn, .job-actions .round-btn` height 32px, min-width 32px, box-sizing border-box.
5. Toasts: `.toast-stack` position fixed, z-index 60, left 50%, bottom 16px, transform translateX(-50%), display flex, flex-direction column, gap 8px, width min(440px, calc(100vw - 32px)), pointer-events none. `.toast` pointer-events auto, display flex, align-items center, justify-content space-between, gap 12px, padding 10px 14px, radius var(--radius), background var(--plum), color var(--mist), border 1px solid rgba(204, 169, 255, 0.25), box-shadow var(--shadow), --text-sm, overflow-wrap anywhere, and an entry animation (opacity 0, translateY(8px) to normal, 170ms). `.toast-error` border-color var(--orange). `.toast .secondary-btn` flex none, padding 6px 12px.
6. Focus rings: `:focus-visible` outline 2px solid var(--accent), outline-offset 2px; inside the header (`.header :focus-visible`) the outline is var(--orange) in both themes (the header is purple). `.job-card:focus-visible, .chip:focus-visible, .tab-btn:focus-visible, .preset-btn:focus-visible, .act-btn:focus-visible, .seg-btn:focus-visible` the same 2px var(--accent) outline. Media elements inside cards (`.job-card audio:focus-visible, .job-card video:focus-visible`) get it too.
7. Search: `.jobs-head` flex-wrap wrap. `.library-search` flex 1 1 180px, max-width 320px, margin-left auto. `#library-search` width 100%, padding 7px 12px, radius 999px, --text-sm. `.job-card.search-miss` display none.
8. Keyboard map: `.keymap` width min(420px, calc(100vw - 32px)), padding var(--space-3), radius 14px, border 1px solid var(--border), background var(--surface), color var(--text), box-shadow var(--shadow). `.keymap::backdrop` background rgba(12, 9, 23, 0.6). `.keymap h2` --text-lg, margin-bottom var(--space-2). `.keymap-list` display grid, grid-template-columns auto 1fr, gap 10px 16px, align-items center, margin-bottom var(--space-3). `.keymap-list dt` white-space nowrap. `.keymap-list dd` color var(--text-2), --text-sm. `kbd` font inherit, --text-xs, weight 700, padding 2px 7px, radius var(--radius-sm), border 1px solid var(--border), border-bottom-width 2px, background var(--surface-2), color var(--text).
9. @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce): `.toast` animation none.
Output only the file.
